parsed.rationale: Both `WXYCBackground.wxycBackgroundDark` (BackgroundGradient.swift:30) and `WXYCGradient.wxycBackgroundDark` (WXYCGradient.swift:31) are exact-duplicate computed properties living in the same package (WXUI). Neither is test, codegen, mock, nor sample-app code. The duplication is almost certainly accidental — the same gradient value was defined independently on two different types. The cleanest Swift resolution is to extract the shared value into a single location within WXUI (e.g., a dedicated `WXYCColors` or `WXYCGradients` namespace, or a protocol extension shared by both types) and remove the redundant definitions from both files.
